# Nuked-OPL3 provenance

This directory vendors the official `nukeykt/Nuked-OPL3` implementation at
commit `765ec962e473aeb767e4cba74ffdc8f588ffbfe8`.

The upstream `opl3.c`, `opl3.h`, and `LICENSE` files are unchanged apart from
repository line-ending normalization. They are built as the separate
`nuked-opl3` CMake target so the LGPL component and its replacement boundary
remain independently reviewable.

Nuked-OPL3 is licensed under LGPL-2.1-or-later. See `LICENSE` in this directory.
wolf3d-lib's own license does not replace or narrow those terms.
